mapper.select: select DIS_ID id, DIS_NAME text from DIS_PRAMS

select distinct PROD_ID id, PROD_NAME text from REP_PROD_INFO where STATUS='E'
and (PROD_ID like '%' || #{search, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%' or PROD_NAME like '%' || #{search, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%')
and p_prod_id is null
and p_prod_id is not null

SELECT PROD_ID id, PROD_NAME text, PROD_RE object FROM rep_prod_info
STATUS = 'E' AND REP_PROD_TYPE != '03'
AND PROD_RE=#{prodRegistNo}
and (PROD_ID like concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%') or PROD_NAME like concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%'))

select distinct RPI.PROD_ID id, RPI.PROD_NAME text from V_REP_PROD_INFO RPI
inner join DIS_PROD_FEEDISCOUNT DPF on DPF.PROD_REGIST_NO=RPI.PROD_RE and DPF.DATA_STATUS='E'
inner join DIS_PROD_ADJUST DPA on DPA.PROD_REGIST_NO=RPI.PROD_RE and DPA.DATA_STATUS='E'
inner join DIS_LARGE_REDEMPTION DLR on DLR.PROD_REGIST_NO=RPI.PROD_RE and DLR.DATA_STATUS='E'
where RPI.STATUS='E' and rep_prod_type in ('01','02') and ISSUE_STATUS ='01'
and (RPI.PROD_ID like '%' || #{search, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%' or RPI.PROD_NAME like '%' || #{search, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%')
${condition}
